# City of Bloomington, Minnesota

> Official municipal website providing comprehensive access to city services, government information, and community resources for residents and businesses.

The City of Bloomington serves as a hub for municipal services, community engagement, and economic development in Minnesota. The site connects residents and businesses to essential services including permits, licensing, parks and recreation, public health, and civic participation.

## Key Topics

- City Council
- City Services
- Parks and Recreation
- Permits and Licensing
- Economic Development
- Government Departments
- Community Resources
- Public Health
- Voting and Registration
- Police Department
- Housing and Redevelopment Authority
- Bloomington Center for the Arts
- Animal Shelter
- Municipal Resources

## Core Services & Portals

- [City of Bloomington MN](https://www.bloomingtonmn.gov): Homepage for City of Bloomington with access to city services and community resources.
- [Residents](https://www.bloomingtonmn.gov/web/residents): Portal for residents to access popular City of Bloomington services.
- [Business](https://www.bloomingtonmn.gov/cob/business): Business resources for permits, licensing, and economic development in Bloomington.

## Government & Administration

- [Government](https://www.bloomingtonmn.gov/cob/government): Overview of City of Bloomington government structure and departments.
- [A to Z Index](https://www.bloomingtonmn.gov/cob/a-to-z-index): Comprehensive A-to-Z directory of City of Bloomington services and departments.

## Community & Events

- [Upcoming Events](https://www.bloomingtonmn.gov/cob/upcoming-events): Calendar of upcoming City of Bloomington events and community activities.
- [News](https://www.bloomingtonmn.gov/cob/news): City of Bloomington news and public notices including planning and ordinances.
